digest.component_or_area: maintenance audit documentation and rebar janitor workflow
propositions: The maintenance audit runbook embeds dated tool inventory, machine state, and capture debris that should be removed from maintained procedure.
The runbook must be rewritten as a rebar-project adapter that delegates audit phases to the packaged janitor skill while retaining project-specific gate commands.
The module limit constraint must be documented as an absolute CI gate sourced from .github/module-size-limit.txt instead of described as a soft cap.
Session logs and tickets must be required as durable artifacts for audit progress, decisions, and discovered work instead of maintaining findings in the runbook.
Historical context and prior findings must be referenced via tickets rather than restated as incident narratives in the procedure documentation.
